newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUBOR dips for 1-mo, steady for 3-mo and 6-mo. [CORRECTED 10:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUBOR dips for 1-mo, steady for 3-mo and 6-mo. [CORRECTED 10:45 GMT]

text.p: Hungary's Budapest Interbank Offered Rates (BUBOR) dipped for the one-month maturity and remained steady for the three-month and six-month maturities, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on its BUBOR Reuters page on Tuesday.
The one-month rate was set at 21.27 percent, down 0.01, while the three-month rate at 21.14 percent and the six-month rate at 21.00 percent, both unchanged.
